mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the lymph vessels into a continuous route was most worthwhile: it showed how fluid gets from around cells back to a vein and why that matters.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the larger lymph vessels to the vein felt a little routine on its own, even though the valve panels helped explain the direction of flow.

surprise.text: I hadn't realized that fluid becomes lymph when it enters these vessels, or that returning it helps prevent buildup around cells.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary, though the last few actions were the only offered combinations rather than choices I worked out independently.

continue.text: I would probably continue: bringing the arm, nerves, blood and fluid return together made me curious how other body systems connect, though the final sequence had few meaningful choices.
